field_principles.flagged_for_v395: Closes discover->ingest->plan: names the strongest method for the .395 planner, conditioned on the .394 outcomes.

methods_mapped.carnot_stack_mapping: Materialize generator/family IDs beside each ARC candidate pool row, then build train-family/test-family splits with exact target hashes and the existing Set-Encoder scoring path.
methods_mapped.experiment_mapping: .395: recover or attach task-family IDs, build an ARC-TGI-style family-disjoint candidate pool, and rerun Set-Encoder versus vote on held-out families.
methods_mapped.failure_mode: Generator-generated data can become its own distribution. The .395 gate must keep original ARC tasks as a held-out sanity read and report family-disjoint and original-task metrics separately.
methods_mapped.name: ARC-TGI task-family generators for cross-game generalization
methods_mapped.source_read: ARC-TGI releases human-validated task-family generators with reasoning-chain templates and task-level constraints for controlled ARC sampling.
methods_mapped.v394_outcome_conditioning: Exp 4258 blocked because game IDs were unrecoverable, while Exp 4256 and Exp 4257 hardened the within-pool selector win. The next question is therefore controlled game-disjoint generalization, not another within-pool rerank.

methods_mapped.carnot_stack_mapping: Add source-kind, generator-family, fold, and target-hash manifests as first-class pool columns before training, then require every reported split to cite those manifests.
methods_mapped.experiment_mapping: .395: pre-register a provenance manifest and reject any selector, synthesis, or cross-game claim whose rows cannot be traced to a source-kind and family split.
methods_mapped.failure_mode: A detector-only clean read can be underpowered or shifted. Treat detector scores as diagnostics and make transparent provenance the acceptance gate.
methods_mapped.name: Reliability Gap benchmark-auditing provenance discipline
methods_mapped.source_read: The paper finds contamination detectors fail under distribution shift and small benchmark scale, and cannot replace transparent data provenance for benchmark-level auditing.
methods_mapped.v394_outcome_conditioning: Exp 4256 survived a provenance-blind feature audit, but the origin probe was high. .395 should preserve explicit source manifests instead of relying on statistical leak detectors after the fact.

methods_mapped.carnot_stack_mapping: Map the Set-Encoder or process verifier score into a token/cell ordering policy for a loader-fixed masked diffusion run, with a tiny smoke before any full ARC budget.
methods_mapped.experiment_mapping: .395 only after loader repair: tiny DPRM-style guided reveal smoke using verifier rewards, then GO/NO-GO for a full DiffusionGemma run.
methods_mapped.failure_mode: Ordering guidance can optimize partial reveal confidence rather than exact ARC grid correctness. Exact-match validation and a selector-only baseline remain mandatory.
methods_mapped.name: DPRM token-ordering guidance for diffusion language models
methods_mapped.source_read: DPRM is a plug-in Doob h-transform process-reward module that keeps the host diffusion LM fixed and changes token ordering through reward-tilted reveal decisions.
methods_mapped.v394_outcome_conditioning: Exp 4260 blocked at the DiffusionGemma GGUF loader, so DPRM is not a full-run recommendation yet. It is the right method to queue after loader repair because it uses verifier/process rewards without changing the base denoiser.

methods_mapped.carnot_stack_mapping: If a diffusion LM loads, use verifier rewards as intermediate advantages over denoising steps instead of final-output-only reward or monolithic live LoRA training.
methods_mapped.experiment_mapping: .395 deferred path: after DiffusionGemma loader repair, run a bounded entropy-step smoke with exact-grid rewards and compare to unguided diffusion.
methods_mapped.failure_mode: The method is a post-training recipe. It will not help while the DiffusionGemma loader is blocked, and sparse ARC exact-match rewards may still be too coarse without per-cell evidence.
methods_mapped.name: Entropy-guided step selection and stepwise advantages for diffusion LLM RL
methods_mapped.source_read: This method formulates diffusion sequence generation as a denoising MDP with exact stepwise policy gradients and entropy-guided step selection for efficient updates.
methods_mapped.v394_outcome_conditioning: Because Exp 4260 never loaded DiffusionGemma and Exp 4259 showed deterministic synthesis underperformed, this belongs behind a loader-repair and smoke gate, not ahead of the cross-game fix.

methods_mapped.carnot_stack_mapping: Attach task-family or reasoning-template embeddings during training of an ARC selector/visual model, then evaluate with those privileged signals removed on held-out families.
methods_mapped.experiment_mapping: .395 ablation: train with and without language/template privileged features on ARC-TGI families, discard them at inference, and score held-out family exact matches.
methods_mapped.failure_mode: Language descriptions can leak hidden rules. The branch must be training-only, family-disjoint, and audited against target leakage before it can support a generalization claim.
methods_mapped.name: L-VARC language-guided abstraction with inference-time visual backbone
methods_mapped.source_read: L-VARC trains a lightweight visual ARC model with a language-guided privileged-information branch, then discards that branch at inference.
methods_mapped.v394_outcome_conditioning: Exp 4259 says naive grid synthesis did not beat selection. L-VARC suggests using language-derived abstractions as training-only structure for generalization, while preserving non-language inference-time claims.
